Use the SimplePad Eigenmode workflow to obtain the mode frequency and requested surface energy participation. Choose whether to prepare a handoff for another AEDT host or run on the model-building host; both routes finish with the same result analysis.

## Choose how to run

| Route | What to do | Check |
|---|---|---|
| Prepare and hand off | Follow [Prepare Handoff](eigenmode/prepare-handoff.qmd): create the package, transfer it to an AEDT host, run it with the existing Run notebook, and return the complete run directory. | The solver host returns the complete run directory. |
| Run on the same AEDT host | Follow [Run Directly](eigenmode/run-directly.qmd): build the model, prepare a new package, execute it on that host, and inspect the returned directory. | The returned directory resolves in the analysis step. |

## Read the returned mode

In a fresh kernel, follow [Analyze](eigenmode/analyze.qmd) with the actual returned run directory. Read the returned mode frequency in GHz and its recorded mode identity and solver status; the configured search minimum is an input, not the solved frequency.

::: {.callout-note title="200 nm historical reference" collapse="true"}
